definition: A sign supplies reusable grammatical components that modify the manner, strategy, pace, orientation, emphasis, sequencing, or regulation of another object's function.
functionalAim: Specify how an approved function or reference frame is expressed without replacing the identity or grammar role of the modified object.
constraints: A sign must remain a modifier.
A sign may not supply the main planetary verb.
A sign may not replace house context or aspect connection.
Every sign component must be reusable across compatible targets.
